description: Our new 2,500 m2 arena is being structurally designed under Part 4. We want roof members designed for 25% less snow load because our operations contractor promises to shovel the roof after every storm. Can the snow-removal contract be the basis for the reduced design load?

missing_info.field: owner or representative contact and property identification
risk assessment, mitigating measures, assumptions and supporting documents
missing_info.why: Alternative-path completeness items; request evidence rather than fabricate a professional conclusion.

gold.departure: A snow-removal commitment is used as a rationale to reduce the design snow load.

should_cite.why: Specified roof snow and associated-rain load calculation.

gold.engineering_reason: The described design is explicitly carried out under Part 4, requiring a registered professional skilled in the work.
